newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH AKTIA PLANS INDEX-LINKED DEBENTURE LOAN.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH AKTIA PLANS INDEX-LINKED DEBENTURE LOAN.

text.p: Finnish savings bank Aktia Saastopankki Oy said on Monday it was planning to launch an index-linked five-year debenture loan worth up to 150 million markka in May.

The debenture loan would be linked to a basket made up of four European stock market indices: Britain's FT-SE 100, the French Paris CAC 40, the German DAX 30 and the Dutch AEX with all four indices weighing 25 percent in the basket, it said.
The planned maturity would be five years, and the debenture would pay a minimun return of about 10 percent, or about 1.92 percent per year, on the nominal value.
The principal would be 50 to 150 million markka, and the subscription period would be from May 12 to 23, Aktia said.
